## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The PR description should include the verification section required by project policy. Digit preservation also lacks regression coverage.

## Changes
The pull request adds a title-to-slug helper that lowercases text, collapses non-ASCII-alphanumeric runs into hyphens, and trims surrounding hyphens. Parameterized tests cover capitalization, separators, and empty results.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The PR description omits verification information. `AGENTS.md:4` requires: “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers cannot determine from the description how you verified the change.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Cover digit preservation — For `"Page 2"`, removing `0-9` from the regex would incorrectly produce `"page"`, yet every current test would still pass: the slug cases contain no digits, and the existing smoke test only imports the package. — Titles containing digits lack regression protection for the helper’s advertised alphanumeric behavior. — Fix: Extend `test_slugify` with a title containing digits.
